# compute_hub_score { #dyf.compute_hub_score }

```python
compute_hub_score(
    embeddings,
    k=30,
    n_iterations=30,
    neighbors=None,
    similarities=None,
)
```

Compute hub score for each point in the embedding space.

Hub score identifies structural hub nodes that hold the embedding space
together, as opposed to popular instances that fill it. The score combines:
- Eigenvector centrality: rewards being in a tightly woven neighborhood
- Distance to global centroid: rewards central position in the space

General/structural concepts score high on both signals; specific instances
score low on both.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                             | Description                                                       | Default    |
|--------------|--------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| embeddings   | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)         | Normalized embeddings (n, d)                                      | _required_ |
| k            | [int](`int`)                                     | Number of neighbors for k-NN graph                                | `30`       |
| n_iterations | [int](`int`)                                     | Iterations for eigenvector power method                           | `30`       |
| neighbors    | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| None | Pre-computed k-NN indices (n, k+1). If None, computed internally. | `None`     |
| similarities | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| None | Pre-computed similarities (n, k+1). If None, computed internally. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                            | Description                                       |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
|        | [HubScoreResult](`dyf.ontology.HubScoreResult`) | HubScoreResult with scores and component signals. |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

>>> result = compute_hub_score(embeddings)
>>> hub_nodes = result.get_hub_nodes(threshold=1.0)
>>> print(f"Found {len(hub_nodes)} hub nodes")
>>>
>>> # Use for taxonomy direction
>>> if result.scores[idx_animal] > result.scores[idx_dog]:
...     print("Animal is more general than Dog")
